# Commands automatic Rust dependency update and isolated promotion

Use SQLite `BEGIN EXCLUSIVE` at `~/.tb-tools/dependency-update/.../run.sqlite`, not a PID/text lock: process death releases the lock. Persist `pending` before preparation/build so a restarted backend retries incomplete work. [Task 1]

Scope: console.
